responsive_ownership.rule: The Sidebar component chooses a mobile Sheet versus desktop offcanvas wrapper. It is not the right workspace sheet.
The <=980px media query chooses a right-side sheet unless the right panel is maximized; otherwise RightPanelTabs is inline.
Maximized right workspace hides the chat column with width zero and inert; it does not create a new native window.

Canvas-measured card placement determines inline absolute aside versus anchored popover. Height measurements choose full/compact/essential density. This is independent of the right-workspace sheet switch.
Details, bottom-terminal and workspace controls move between chat header, root and workspace titlebar according to inline/sheet ownership. They remain three separate toggles.
Embedded ChatView suppresses outer header, floating details, mini-player, terminal drawer and its own workspace container. It retains the embedded conversation/composer and relevant own dialogs.
AppRouteModal uses full small-screen bounds and inset/rounded larger-screen popup bounds. Background chat remains mounted under the route modal.
PullRequestsPage directly instantiates RightPanelTabs with mode inline. The chat-only <=980 sheet rule must not be inferred for this root.
